params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$manager=@'
param(
  [ValidateSet('START','STOP','STATUS','BUILD','VERIFY','BURST-ON','BURST-OFF','EXEC','RUNALL')]
  [string]$Action='STATUS',
  [ValidateSet('worker01','worker02','worker03','worker04','worker05','worker06','worker07','worker08')]
  [string]$Worker='worker01',
  [Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
  [string[]]$Command
)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$LinuxRoot='/mnt/c/HeavenServices/worker-fabric'

function Invoke-Ubuntu([string]$Script) {
  $b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($Script))
  & wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "echo $b64 | base64 -d | bash"
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw "Ubuntu command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
}

switch($Action){
  'BUILD' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose build" }
  'START' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose up -d worker01 worker02 worker03 worker04" }
  'STOP' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst stop" }
  'BURST-ON' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst up -d worker05 worker06 worker07 worker08" }
  'BURST-OFF' { Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst stop worker05 worker06 worker07 worker08" }
  'STATUS' {
    Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst ps && echo && docker stats --no-stream --format 'table {{.Name}}\t{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}\t{{.PIDs}}' heaven-worker-01 heaven-worker-02 heaven-worker-03 heaven-worker-04 2>/dev/null || true"
  }
  'VERIFY' {
    foreach($w in 'worker01','worker02','worker03','worker04'){
      Write-Host "===$w==="
      Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose exec -T $w sh -lc 'hostname; node -v; python3 --version; git --version; rg --version | head -1'"
    }
  }
  'EXEC' {
    if(-not $Command -or $Command.Count -eq 0){ throw 'EXEC requires a command after the worker name.' }
    $cmd=($Command -join ' ')
    $inner=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($cmd))
    Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose --profile burst exec -T $Worker bash -lc 'echo $inner | base64 -d | bash'"
  }
  'RUNALL' {
    if(-not $Command -or $Command.Count -eq 0){ throw 'RUNALL requires a command.' }
    $cmd=($Command -join ' ')
    $inner=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($cmd))
    foreach($w in 'worker01','worker02','worker03','worker04'){
      Write-Host "===$w==="
      Invoke-Ubuntu "cd $LinuxRoot && docker compose exec -T $w bash -lc 'echo $inner | base64 -d | bash'"
    }
  }
}
'@
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1",$manager,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

Write-Output '--- MANAGER VERIFY ---'
& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 VERIFY
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'Manager VERIFY failed' }

Write-Output '--- ISOLATION + SHARED EXCHANGE ---'
$test=@'
set -e
cd /mnt/c/HeavenServices/worker-fabric
docker compose exec -T worker01 sh -lc 'echo worker01-private > /workspace/private.txt; echo FABRIC_SHARED_OK > /shared/fabric-smoke.txt'
docker compose exec -T worker02 sh -lc 'test ! -e /workspace/private.txt'
test "$(docker compose exec -T worker04 sh -lc 'cat /shared/fabric-smoke.txt' | tr -d "\r")" = "FABRIC_SHARED_OK"
echo ISOLATION_OK
echo SHARED_EXCHANGE_OK
echo BASE_LIMITS
docker inspect heaven-worker-01 --format 'NanoCPUs={{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}} Memory={{.HostConfig.Memory}} Pids={{.HostConfig.PidsLimit}} Mounts={{range .Mounts}}{{.Type}}:{{.Destination}};{{end}}'
echo BASE_PORTS
docker port heaven-worker-01 || true
docker compose ps
docker stats --no-stream --format 'table {{.Name}}\t{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}\t{{.PIDs}}' heaven-worker-01 heaven-worker-02 heaven-worker-03 heaven-worker-04
'@
$b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($test))
& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "echo $b64 | base64 -d | bash"
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'Base fabric isolation/shared test failed' }

Write-Output '--- BURST TIER TEST ---'
& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 BURST-ON
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'BURST-ON failed' }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 12
$burst=@'
set -e
cd /mnt/c/HeavenServices/worker-fabric
for w in worker05 worker06 worker07 worker08; do
  docker compose --profile burst exec -T "$w" sh -lc 'hostname; node -v; python3 --version'
done
docker inspect heaven-worker-05 --format 'BURST_LIMITS NanoCPUs={{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}} Memory={{.HostConfig.Memory}} Pids={{.HostConfig.PidsLimit}}'
docker compose --profile burst ps
'@
$b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($burst))
& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "echo $b64 | base64 -d | bash"
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'Burst verification failed' }

& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 BURST-OFF
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'BURST-OFF failed' }

Write-Output '--- FINAL HOST HEADROOM ---'
$headroom=@'
echo WSL_MEMORY
free -h
echo GPU
/mnt/c/Windows/System32/nvidia-smi.exe --query-gpu=name,memory.total,memory.used,memory.free,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null || true
echo WORKER_STATUS
cd /mnt/c/HeavenServices/worker-fabric && docker compose --profile burst ps
'@
$b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($headroom))
& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "echo $b64 | base64 -d | bash"
exit $LASTEXITCODE
